scientific_integrity: The exact rational non-product rank and one explicit integral cycle are supported by a complete signed chain computation. This is a same-model reviewed result, not an independently audited or formally certified theorem.
scientific_limitations: The free rank of the quotient by disjoint-simple-cycle tori is one; its finite torsion and integral saturation are uncomputed.
The comparison with singular homology uses the published reduced Swiatkowski comparison theorem.
Further unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: A non-product third-homology class for three particles on the four-cube graph
